top_stories.title: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
top_stories.description: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. top_stories.title: A timeline of developments in AI safety since the attack on Hugging Face
top_stories.description: In one alarming announcement after another, artificial intelligence companies in recent months have shared examples of their technology acting in ways that appeared to evade instructions from humans.
